title: Driftwood Dreams Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
description_expanded: **SNOWBIRD PROMOTION- Save 50% PER NIGHT January and February for monthly stays!** HOME HIGHLIGHTS -$25 Publix Gift Card included for October and November 2025 rentals! - ACCESS TO THE PUBLIC WIDE BEACH (OR PRIVATE FOR MAIN TOWNS) WITH NO RESTRICTIONS. - 2 parking spots available - 2 adult sized beach cruiser bikes included - Private grill - Fully stocked kitchen complete with standard drip coffee maker - Access to the community pool, tennis courts, and pickleball courts - Short 5-minute walk to the beach, community pool, shopping, and dining - Sandpiper Linen Program Participant: All linen, bedding and bath, are the highest quality. OPTIONAL ADD-ONS: **Optional Cancellation Protection**- Allows cancellation for ANY reason up to 48 hours in advance of stay and guarantees 50% of all monies paid returned ($100 fee applies at booking). Recently purchased and redecorated by interior designer, this 2-bedroom townhome is a 3-minute walk to the beach and is steps away from the community pool! Located in the private Seagrove community of Cassine Gardens, Driftwood Dreams offers an updated kitchen with granite countertops and new appliances, tile and hardwood flooring throughout. Open concept living space with sleeper sofa and updated half bath on the main level. Upstairs are 2 spacious bedrooms with walk-in closets. The king master bedroom has a private bathroom with bath/shower combo and private balcony. Closet is large enough to fit a pack-n-play! The upstairs guest bedroom offers 2 queen size beds (sleeps 4) with private balcony and hall bathroom with bath/shower combo. The downstairs patio offers outdoor space to sit and relax after your beach day, a closet with washer/dryer and a private BBQ grill.
